name: everos-memory
description: Automatic long-term memory for Claude Code, backed by a self-hosted EverOS server (recall on prompt submit, deferred capture on turn stop, batched extraction on flush).

apiVersion.title: API version
apiVersion.description: EverOS API version to use: auto, v1, or v2

projectId.title: Project ID override
projectId.description: Fixed EverOS project partition id (defaults to a hash of the working directory if left empty)

userId.title: User ID override
userId.description: Developer identity for the EverOS user track (defaults to the OS account name if left empty)

agentId.title: Agent ID
agentId.description: Agent identity for the EverOS agent track

recallMethod.title: Recall method
recallMethod.description: EverOS retrieval method: keyword, vector, hybrid, or agentic

enableLlmRerank.title: Enable LLM rerank
enableLlmRerank.description: Route hybrid search through the LLM rerank lane instead of requiring a cross-encoder rerank provider

queryN.title: Recall query history depth
queryN.description: Number of recent direct user messages blended into each recall query

queryMaxChars.title: Recall query character budget
queryMaxChars.description: Character budget for the recall query

recallTopK.title: Recall top-K
recallTopK.description: Maximum results requested per EverOS owner track

recallMaxChars.title: Recall injection character budget
recallMaxChars.description: Total character budget for injected recalled memory

recallTimeoutMs.title: Recall timeout (ms)
recallTimeoutMs.description: Per-attempt timeout for the primary recall method (hybrid+rerank makes a real LLM call; budget accordingly)

recallRetries.title: Recall retry attempts
recallRetries.description: How many times to try the primary recall method before falling back

recallFallbackMethod.title: Recall fallback method
recallFallbackMethod.description: Method used if the primary recall method fails/times out on every retry (keyword never depends on rerank)

recallFallbackTimeoutMs.title: Recall fallback timeout (ms)
recallFallbackTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for the fallback recall call

flushIdleMs.title: Idle flush delay (ms)
flushIdleMs.description: Flush after this much inactivity following a captured turn

flushTokenThreshold.title: Flush token threshold
flushTokenThreshold.description: Flush when the approximate buffered token count reaches this threshold

flushMessageThreshold.title: Flush message threshold
flushMessageThreshold.description: Flush when the buffered message count reaches this threshold

flushMaxDelayMs.title: Max flush delay (ms)
flushMaxDelayMs.description: Maximum time a non-empty buffer may remain unflushed

flushOnSessionSwitch.title: Flush on session switch
flushOnSessionSwitch.description: Flush other pending sessions in the same project before a new session recalls
